routes.title: Bounded-Refined Aperiodic Dichroic Stack
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Constraining individual layer thicknesses to a maximum of 280nm and increasing mutation step-sizes in the 100-150nm regime will redistribute sampling density to resolve narrow spectral features, improving dual-band performance and altering the tightest_margin relative to the unbounded 24-layer baseline.
routes.design_principle: Aperiodic thickness optimization with bounded search space to prevent non-manufacturable outliers while enhancing search resolution in critical thickness regimes.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer aperiodic stack on Fused Silica substrate, Air incidence.
manufacturing_considerations: Individual layer thickness <= 280nm to avoid excessive stress/deposition time
known_risks: Bounded space may exclude global optimum if >280nm layers are physically required
routes.execution_request_english: Design a 24-layer planar dielectric stack on a Fused Silica substrate with Air incidence using HfO2 and SiO2. Optimize layer thicknesses using differential evolution with the following constraints: 1) Each layer thickness must be initialized and bounded between 50nm and 280nm (hard cap). 2) Increase mutation step-sizes specifically for thickness values in the 100-150nm regime to enhance sampling density there. 3) Target objective: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565nm band and mean reflectance in 400-700nm band simultaneously. 4) Evaluate performance using coherent TMM at normal incidence. 5) Report best_target_score, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all valid candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
routes.revision_reason: Refinement of route_02 based on iteration_02 observations: narrowed initialization bounds for layers exceeding 280nm (observed up to 350nm) and adjusted mutation strategy to focus on intermediate thickness regions as per feedback directives.

research_influence: Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:92993850:s2chunk:92993850:1765:3736:69b2ad685bc8c493 confirms the application context (telecom C-band QKD) motivating the strict spectral separation requirements, supporting the prioritization of the 1530-1565nm transmission band.
unresolved_decisions: Exact incidence angle remains unspecified in original request; normal incidence assumed based on prior iteration compilation rationale.
plan.stop_if_all_routes_fail: Stop after the bounded route portfolio is exhausted or further search stagnates. Return every physically verified candidate and report soft objective trade-offs without a performance admission threshold.
